title: Original Cozy Tabletop Still Life
visual_specification: Original separated ceramic mug and hollow bowl, clear closed-shell decanter, lidded metal can and emitting candle over an original wood-grain tabletop, with physical shallow focus and Image curves/vignette.
required_feature_witnesses: warm area key and candle-area fill
rights_note: 100% original procedural scene; no Splash, Cozy Kitchen, CC-BY-SA, HDRI, texture, font or borrowed model asset.
limitations: Authored original scene; no spectral or measured-physical-material claim.
Candle glow is an authored area emitter; no external flame image is used.
A0.5mm decanter/table clearance avoids ambiguous coplanar dielectric contact.

denoise_worker_policy.scope: Source child process sets the pinned OIDN_NUM_THREADS device override; ray tracing retains four workers.

grading_profile.purpose: Monotone highlight roll-off without amplification of the native RGBA8 precision.

geometry_policy.reason: A distinct air interface avoids coincident glass and wood faces.
